svg.title: About / Sobre mim
svg.desc: I'm a creative thinker who likes the moment an idea becomes something real. I connect strategy, marketing, design and technology to build products and systems that solve real problems. Sou movido por ideias e pelo momento em que elas viram algo real. Conecto estratégia, marketing, design e tecnologia para criar produtos e sistemas que resolvem problemas reais. I study logistics, which shapes how I think about processes, operations and systems. A blue square travels a line from idea to strategy, design, system and product.
